findings.text: the done-when's head arm stops at 43 percent with no summary and no EXIT= line, its header names revision 6d5c4655 which is the first of the run's three commits, its command runs -n 10 where the done-when names -n 4, and the base arm at clone_gate_base.log:1 stops at 40 percent the same way, so the two commits after 6d5c4655 including the promoted head have no completed gate observation and the run's added failures are underivable.

the log's own header names revision 60b209380 while the run it reports is the three-test file whose third test exists only in a869cc1e, committed thirty seconds after the log was written, so the manifest's cited evidence identifies a revision that does not contain the code it exercised and the promoted head carries no log stamped at it.

both clone-report tests promote a run that adds a new file, so the goal's other half — a function the run modifies inside a file the base already carries — is exercised by no test, and a regression narrowing the detector to added files would leave the suite green.

item_verdicts.diff: read all three commits against base 4e05e287; 6d5c4655 ports the detector and wires promotion, 60b209380 declares the ledger field, and a869cc1e replaces the empty-list default with the ledger.unmeasured_clone_report marker and adds the test that separates an unmeasured run from one measured to copy nothing, repairing the previous review's first finding.
item_verdicts.done_when: its detector-port and no-docs-import conditions hold (reckon/clones.py:40-77 reproduces docs/research/data/crew-pattern-review/code-depth/census.py:38-71 line for line and no module under reckon/ imports from docs/), the file holding its two named tests passes 3 of 3 at the promoted head in this reviewer's own replay (reviewer_replay_head_tests.log, 3 passed, EXIT=0), and its /tmp cleanup condition holds (no clone-* directory remains); its base-and-head arm condition does not hold.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to report at promotion each function a run adds or modifies that copies an existing function under the six-line normalised detector ported into reckon/clones.py, and reckon/crew/promotion.py:5705 calls clones.promotion_clone_matches over the run's changed functions into ledger.build_record at reckon/crew/promotion.py:5769 under the declared field clone_matches (reckon/ledger.py:148) with both functions' file:line and no effect on the gate; the plan section's other two clauses name reckon/crew/review.py and reckon/velocity.py, neither of which is in this node's write paths.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states complete with the three tests at EXIT=0 and a negative control whose red log's first line repeats the declared string verbatim, but it records neither baseline_suite nor after_suite, so its cited results name revision 60b209380 rather than the promoted head a869cc1e and no reader can derive its added failures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the six declared paths were read from the run prompt; the three commits change five of them and nothing outside them — reckon/clones.py, reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/ledger.py, tests/test_promotion_reports_clones.py and the evidence fragment — and the sixth, the figures directory, is unused, as the done-when names no artifact.

justifications.durability: tests/test_promotion_reports_clones.py:186 compares the reported line against an ast parse of the fixture rather than against the value under test and reddens under the declared mutation, but tests/test_promotion_reports_clones.py:158 covers only a function the run adds, leaving the goal's modified-in-place half unguarded.
justifications.evidence: the named tests are green at the promoted head in this reviewer's replay but the done_when's own arm condition is unmet at clone_gate_head.log:1, which stops at 43% with no summary and no EXIT= line, so the run's added failures cannot be derived by anyone.
justifications.fit: reckon/clones.py:55-77 keeps the census's own function names and normalisation, its docstring cites docs/research/data/crew-pattern-review/code-depth/census.py which exists at 38095 bytes, and the changed files carry no plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion.py:5696-5713 measures the run's changed functions against reckon/ and tests/ at the promoted revision and records each match under clone_matches without touching the gate verdict, which is what the goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the three commits is inside the six declared write paths, and the only wide-reaching edit is the single RECORD_FIELDS entry at reckon/ledger.py:148 that the goal's "under a declared field" requires.
